NHPC JE Result 2025-26 is Out at nhpcindia.com on 7th January 2026. The NHPC Junior Engineer exam was held on 29th October 2025 for 248 JE vacancies across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical and E&C disciplines. Now the official Result and Merit List PDF has been released with names and roll numbers of candidates who have qualified in the Computer‑Based Test (CBT) and shortlisted for the DV round. Along with the official Result, NHPC has issued the DV Schedule and venue for all qualified aspirants, scheduled from 21st to 23rd January 2026. Candidates should download the result PDF to confirm their status and prepare for the DV process as per the notice.

NHPC JE Result 2026 Out

The NHPC JE Result 2026 has been officially released on the NHPC Limited website for candidates who appeared in the Junior Engineer (JE) examination conducted under Advt. No. NH/Rectt./04/2025. The result is published in the form of a Merit List PDF containing Names and Roll Nos. of shortlisted candidates who have qualified the Computer‑Based Test (CBT) and are now eligible for DV and final appointment. Candidates should download the Result PDF and verify their qualifying status immediately.

NHPC Junior Engineer Result 2026: Overview

The NHPC JE Recruitment 2025‑26 is being conducted for 248 vacancies. The CBT was conducted on 29th October 2025. Following the exam and provisional answer key release, the result has now been declared. The selection process is based on candidates’ performance in the CBT, and shortlisted candidates will now proceed to document verification.

Parameter Details
Recruiting Body National Hydroelectric Power Corporation Ltd (NHPC)
Post Junior Engineer (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, E&C)
Result Format Merit List PDF
Exam Date 29th October 2025
Result Date 7th January 2026
Number of Vacancies 248
Official Website www.nhpcindia.com

nhpcindia.com NHPC JE Result 2026 PDF Download Link

The NHPC JE Result 2026 PDF is available for download from the NHPC official careers section. Candidates must use the official Merit List PDF to check their qualifying status and then prepare for document verification. The direct NHPC JE Merit List PDF 2026 is provided below.

👉 Download NHPC JE Result 2026 PDF

How to Download NHPC JE Result 2026?

To download the official NHPC PE Result and Merit List PDF, visit the official NHPC official website at www.nhpcindia.com. Follow the steps given below to download the Merit List PDF:

  1. Go to the official NHPC website at www.nhpcindia.com.
  2. Navigate to the Career / Results section.
  3. Look for the link titled “NHPC JE Result 2026”.
  4. Click the link to open the Merit List PDF.
  5. Use Ctrl + F and enter your Registration Number to find your name.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Details Mentioned on NHPC JE Result 2026

The NHPC JE Result  has been released in the form of a Merit List PDF containing the names and roll numbers of candidates selected for final appointment as Junior Engineer against Advt. No. NH/Rectt./04/2025. Make sure to check the following details carefully.

  1. Roll Number of candidate
  2. Candidate Name 
  3. Category (General / OBC / SC / ST / EWS)
  4. Post Applied For (JE Discipline)
  5. Qualifying Status
  6. DV Date

NHPC Junior Engineer Result 2026 Out – What’s Next?

Now that the NHPC JE Result 2026 has been declared, qualified candidates must appear for the Document Verification round from 21st to 23rd January 2026 at the NHPC Office Complex in Faridabad, Haryana. During document verification, candidates must carry original certificates for proof of age, educational qualification, category certificates (if applicable), and any other required credentials. After successful verification, the final merit list will be updated, and appointment letters will be issued to candidates as per NHPC recruitment norms. 

NHPC JE DV Schedule 2026 Out

The NHPC Junior Engineer Document Verification (DV) schedule has been announced. Candidates shortlisted in the NHPC JE Result 2026 must attend the DV on the specified dates. Below is the complete DV schedule:

JE (Civil) 21.01.2026 & 22.01.2026 Ground Floor Hall, Neer Shakti Sadan, NHPC Office Complex, Sector-33, Faridabad, Haryana 10:00 AM
JE (Elect.) 22.01.2026
JE (Mech.) 23.01.2026
JE (E&C) 23.01.2026
Supervisor (IT) 23.01.2026
Senior Accountant 23.01.2026

NHPC JE Result 2026 FAQs

Q1: Where can I check the NHPC JE Result 2026?
You can check the NHPC JE Result 2026 on the official NHPC website nhpcindia.com under the Career / Results section and download the PDF merit list.

Q2: What should I do if my registration number is in the result PDF?
If your registration number appears in the result PDF, you are shortlisted for document verification. Follow instructions on the portal and prepare original documents.

Q3: Will NHPC release individual scorecards for JE 2026?
Yes. The NHPC JE Scorecard will be released separately. Candidates can download it using their login credentials.

Q4: Where will the document verification details be announced?
NHPC has announced the DV schedule and venue along with the Result PDF. The Document Verification for all shortlisted candidates will be done from 21st to 23rd January 2026 post wise at NHPC Office Complex, Faridabad.

Q5: What if I don’t find my name or registration number in the result?
If your registration number is not in the PDF, it means you did not qualify for the CBT stage. Such candidates can now prepare for future recruitment cycles.
